description: Find beauty providers in France and Togo and manage your own appointments.

interface.longDescription: BeautyGo helps you find beauty providers in France and Togo (hair, barber, nails, lashes and brows, skincare) by city, service, price and rating, see their free time slots, and manage your own appointments: book, reschedule and cancel. Every action starts with a preview and only happens after you confirm it. BeautyGo never charges you in the chat and never shows a payment link: services are paid to the provider as agreed with them, and services that require a deposit are booked in the BeautyGo app.
